source.exact_quote:
With commercial insurance: pay as little as $25 per month, subject to a max savings of $100/month.

Self-pay pricing varies by dose. Patients pay $149 for each month of 1.5 mg and 4 mg. 4 mg offer only available until August 31, 2026, then $199 per month for 4 mg.

Patients new to the Wegovy Savings offer or NovoCare Pharmacy pay $199 for each month of 0.25 mg and 0.5 mg. Offer for 2 monthly fills through December 31, 2026, then $349 per month for Wegovy 0.25 mg, 0.5 mg, 1 mg, 1.7 mg, or 2.4 mg and $399 per month for Wegovy HD 7.2 mg.

Savings are available for people using commercial insurance or those who are uninsured/self-paying (not going through insurance) with a valid prescription. Government-insured patients may use this program if they self pay and process outside of their insurance.

source.exact_quote:
The $299 per month is for the Zepbound KwikPen or vial, not Zepbound single-dose Pen.

For patients who have been prescribed Zepbound single-dose pen and have commercial drug insurance that does not provide coverage for Zepbound single-dose pen: You must have commercial drug insurance that does not cover Zepbound single-dose pen and a prescription for an approved use consistent with FDA-approved product labeling to pay as low as $499 for your 1-month prescription fill of Zepbound single-dose pen.

Regular price for a 1-month supply of Zepbound single-patient-use KwikPen is $299 for 2.5 mg, $399 for 5 mg, $499 for 7.5 mg, $699 for 10 mg, $699 for 12.5 mg, and $699 for 15 mg.

Card may be used for a maximum of up to 11 prescription fills per calendar year. Card expires and savings end on 12/31/2026.
